item.skt: lo ka a ti ta sta pa
item.coloph: 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs s+ho// rgya gar gyi mkhan po kri sna ban di da dang/ lo tsa ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa

item.skt: lo ka a ti Sh+Tha ste pa
item.coloph: 'jig rten las 'das par stod pa las/ bslob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs s+ho// rgya gar gyi mkhan po kriSh+Na pa Na Di ta dang/ lo ts+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas sgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa
